comparison.objective: Set a grinder dial, load beans, and turn its crank; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Selector rotation, granular pouring, and crank operation versus adjustment screw counterholding during jam-nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Dial at 30°, beans loaded, crank completes a turn, cup returned versus locked 90° opening retained across cycles.
comparison.reason: Although both set a rotary value and operate a mechanism, the grinder lacks locking under reaction torque and retention verification.
